title: I02 APOLLO AQUATHERM engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

heat_input.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

mass_flow.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.
mass_flow.x-quality-rule: Positive accepted range; missing flow blocks heat-rate estimate.

fluid_state.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

thermal_graph.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.
thermal_graph.x-quality-rule: Conservative internal links and verified geometry.

sensor_cov.x-dimension: row/column ordering and dimensions frozen in ICD

energy_ledger.description: Input, uptake, loss and stored energy.
energy_ledger.x-quality-rule: Instantaneous power and cumulative energy separate.

hotspot_prediction.x-encoding: posterior record: representation is explicit; weights and sample dimensions require domain validation.
hotspot_prediction.x-quality-rule: Sensor coverage and model discrepancy attached.

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
